name: EquipmentCompetencyVocTracker
tagline: Verification of competency, authorisation cards, re-VOC planning and crew coverage for mobile plant – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete mining workforce-competency app: register operator × equipment class records, log training hours against class thresholds, book assessments with accredited assessors, record results against the pass mark, sign off independently, issue authorisation cards, plan re-VOCs before expiry and check that every crew has enough authorised operators for critical equipment. Works the moment it is dropped with fictional demo data; connect Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or a collection in a few clicks.
features: Assessment booking (single and bulk) with accredited assessors
Expiry warnings, expired stand-down and re-VOC planner
Suspension and reinstatement with mandatory reasons
Crew × equipment coverage matrix with critical classes
Grouping, multi-select bulk actions, Undo, CSV export
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: EquipmentCompetencyVocTracker data-set + EquipmentCompetencyVocTrackerPortal field control)
